notes.subject: רחיט
notes.rationale: רחיט appears only here in the Tanakh; 'so finfinw' (roof panels) keeps the literal picture of inset boards.

notes.subject: ye … ye
notes.rationale: Hebrew is verbless nominal clause; Bamanankan copula ye…ye supplied and bracketed.

notes.subject: rafter
notes.rationale: Some versions render קורות as 'rafters' and רחיט as 'rafters/panels'; here kokorow (beams) vs finfinw (panels) keeps the two words distinct.

translation: An ka so kokorow ⟨ye⟩ kaduguw ⟨ye⟩, an ka so finfinw ⟨ye⟩ berow ⟨ye⟩.
